question: Which of the following is NOT a correct match of Dargah and its respective location?

options.text: Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki Dargah - Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya Dargah - Agra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya Dargah Situated in the Nizamuddin West area of **Delhi.**
 
• Nizamuddin Dargah is the dargah (mausoleum) of the Sufi saint **Khwaja Nizamuddin Auliya (1238–1325 CE).**
 
• Nizamuddin Dargah built-in 1325 by Khizr Khan, the son of Alauddin Khalji (r. 1296-1316), and is the oldest building in the Nizamuddin area.
